title: Render a procedural material
description: Paint a marble material with a typed palette, resolution, and synchronous renderer.
notes: The borrowed source and mask canvases are used only inside the render callback.

title: Paint reaction diffusion
description: Mount an interactive reaction-diffusion layer with a typed brush.
notes: The layer owns its simulation until the CRC controller is disposed.

title: Compare three material recipes
description: Compare labeled marble, paper, and cellular swatches with palettes that reveal their surface detail.
notes: Each hook slot owns one texture resource; the returned handle is directly usable as fill.

title: Send paint to a living ink texture
description: Create a reaction-diffusion recipe and send a typed paint command on click.
notes: Messages are sent from the event handler, outside component evaluation.

title: Ripple a wave map
description: Refract and light a tiled sign through fine, fast-moving waves, with an unfiltered comparison toggle.
notes: Press anywhere on the image to add a ripple at that position. Turn off Refraction + reflections to see the undistorted source. Scale 10 produces finer periodic waves; speed 2.4 animates them more quickly. Both filters share the same numeric wave map and region.

title: Ripple around an obstacle
description: Use a bounded water surface with a normalized rectangular obstacle.
notes: Press to ripple the tiled image. The outlined island marks the normalized obstacle, which affects the height field rather than Canvas hit testing.

title: Refract through rain glass
description: Use a rain map for displacement and localized condensation blur.
notes: Drag across the glass to wipe condensation with typed finger messages. Toggle Fogged glass to compare with the original; CRC owns animation and texture cleanup.

title: Add a weighted filament source
description: Attach electric filaments to typed source sites and add one on click.
notes: Source coordinates are normalized to the complete texture, including its padding.

title: Connect two electric points
description: Render a lightning recipe and reset its deterministic seed on click.
notes: The texture owns its animation through CRC; no application frame loop is needed.
